extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from local XML/PDF text and figures; direct mechanism labels are limited to assays performed in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: APB-13 inhibits the TGEV replication phase in ST cells; pretreatment, attachment, penetration, release, and direct virion-killing assays showed little or no effect, while 62.50 µg/mL APB-13 lowered replication-phase viral titer by 3.63 log10TCID50/mL versus virus control.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: APB-13 / indolicidin tested against TGEV HN-2012 in ST cells

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=30:In vitro inhibitory effect of APB-13 on TGEV
source_locator.note: Primary XML reports replication-phase inhibition and direct-killing/attachment/penetration/release controls.
PDF text extraction contains the replication-phase result.
Figure 2 panels C-E visually checked for phase-specific TCID50 patterns.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact figure bar heights beyond the 3.63 log10TCID50/mL text value were not digitized.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: APB-13 reduces TGEV N gene mRNA and N protein expression in infected ST cells, with significant differences for 62.50 µg/mL versus virus control at 24 hpi and protein-level differences at 24 and 30 hpi.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=31:APB-13 decreases the mRNA and protein levels of the TGEV N protein
source_locator.note: Primary XML reports N mRNA and protein expression effects.
PDF text extraction contains the N mRNA/protein result.
Figure 3 was visually checked for RT-qPCR and WB/densitometry panels.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Quantitative bar heights are figure-only; the final claim is limited to text-supported direction/significance and assay class.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: In piglets, APB-13 treatment is associated with lower rectal TGEV shedding on days 3 and 4 and improved small-intestine morphology compared with virus-only controls; this supports in vivo antiviral effect but is not assigned as a molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TGEV-infected piglets receiving APB-13 feed treatment

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=33:Viral shedding in the rectum of the TGEV-infected piglets

mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotype-level in vivo support; no host immune pathway mechanism is directly tested.
